# GitHub Copilot Instructions



Read AGENTS.md and docs/requirements.md before making changes.



This repository is an educational AI-assisted development project.



When working on an issue:



\- understand the requested behavior before writing code

\- inspect the existing codebase first

\- keep changes limited to the scope of the issue

\- do not implement future features

\- prefer simple and readable C#

\- preserve existing behavior

\- validate the result before considering the task complete



When creating or reviewing a pull request:



\- explain important implementation decisions

\- point out assumptions

\- identify possible edge cases

\- mention what was tested
